replacements.reason: Provide one fixed zeroed text state carrier per HUD slot. These objects are never rendered or formatted and require no allocation.
Retain the original HUD GObj process and its scheduler position, but omit its sole effect: formatting a cached score into presentation text.
Preserve HUD GObj replacement, creation order, class, process priority, and per-slot state while replacing SisLib allocation/formatting with a fixed carrier. Score text has no gameplay consumer.
Preserve HUD state initialization without creating a SisLib camera/context. The context id is consumed only by the bounded text constructor.
